patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Lusha's shape. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Lusha leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences..
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Lusha-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene..

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over..

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Lusha's motion (B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, si)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
